        bytes.iter().filter(|&&b| b == b'"').count()
    }

hint.instructions: Which loop-vectorization hint should the build apply to this loop?

criteria.keep_default: Leave the LLVM cost-model decision unchanged (VF=4, IC=4).
criteria.width_16: Set llvm.loop.vectorize.width=16 so the byte compare runs on 16 lanes; accumulator widening moves out of the inner loop.
criteria.width_32: Set llvm.loop.vectorize.width=32 (maximize bandwidth for i8 data); 32 bytes per vector op.
criteria.width_32_interleave_2: Set llvm.loop.vectorize.width=32 and llvm.loop.interleave.count=2 to add a second independent accumulator chain.

expected_gain.instructions: How much faster is this loop likely to get with the best candidate above, compared with keep_default?
